blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Police are looking into allegations that a jealous former boyfriend could have been the one who caused the killing of a 40-year-old pharmacist along V. Rama Avenue in Barangay Calamba, Cebu City, at past 11 a.m. on Tuesday, November 10. As of this posting, police are still investigating and trying to unmask and arrest the gunman, who shot and killed the victim, Marjorie Llaguno, a pharmacist and a single mother of five children. Police continue the hot-pursuit operation against the shooter and a cohort and have called on the public to help them identify and arrest the […]...
